scoring_justification: The headline result—optimal h and α ranges—can be recomputed from the agent’s amplitude_ratio_map.csv by applying a hidden zeroth-amplitude constraint and then comparing to the paper’s reported ranges. No self-reported metric is trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference ranges for optimal h and α, and hidden zeroth-amplitude cutoff for optimum selection
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: 'optimal groove depths near h≈65 nm, inclination angles in the range α≈20°–30°, … period d≈0.6 µm' (text); Figs 2–3 show optimum with low zeroth amplitude. The 0.2 ceiling is chosen to exclude high-ratio regimes with moderate zeroth amplitude observed in Fig. 3.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from the paper’s explicit statements and figure values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The paper itself reports these optimal parameter ranges; the checker merely uses them as a comparison target. The zeroth threshold is set from the paper’s amplitude plots (Fig. 3) where optimum zeroth amplitude is ~0.08, and a liberal ceiling preserves tolerance for implementation differences.

outputs.description: Full grid of the amplitude ratio |H_z,-1⁺|/|H_z,+1⁺| and the zeroth-order reflected amplitude |H_z,0⁺| as functions of groove depth (nm) and inclination angle (deg). The checker recomputes the optimal point from this data and scores it against the paper's optimal ranges.

Agent-reported optimal grating parameters (h, α, period, and the corresponding ratio and zeroth amplitude). The checker verifies that these values are consistent with the agent’s own amplitude_ratio_map.csv.

output_contract.notes: The task focuses only on the lamellar grating case with period d=600 nm and groove width c=0.4d. Sinusoidal profiles, Poynting vector maps, and SPP effective index calculation are excluded per the reproduction scope.

steps.description: Recompute optimal (h,α) from amplitude_ratio_map.csv with hidden zeroth-amplitude ceiling and compare to paper ranges.
Verify that reported optimal_parameters are consistent with the agent's own amplitude_ratio_map.csv.
